system.name: HeteroInfer
system.one_liner: a mobile LLM inference engine that jointly exploits GPU and NPU accelerators via profiling-guided heterogeneous parallelism

components.name: Weight
components.role: weight tensor of shape hidden_size x row, split by row into NPU and GPU sub-tensors

components.name: NPU
components.role: sub-tensor of the weight matrix assigned to the NPU (top rows)

components.name: GPU
components.role: sub-tensor of the weight matrix assigned to the GPU (bottom rows)

components.name: Activation
components.role: activation tensor multiplied with the weight (transposed) to produce output

components.name: Output
components.role: result of Weight x Activation^T, likewise split into NPU/GPU sub-outputs

components.name: Execution Graph
components.role: runtime computation graph implementing the weight-centric partition

components.name: GPU-Graph
components.role: entry/exit sub-graph running fully on GPU before/after the split region

components.name: Split & Sync
components.role: splits the graph execution across NPU and GPU and synchronizes them

components.name: NPU Sub-graph
components.role: portion of the computation graph executed on the NPU

components.name: NPU Partition
components.role: the NPU's assigned partition of weight-centric computation

components.name: GPU Partition
components.role: the GPU's assigned partition of weight-centric computation

components.name: GPU Sub-graph
components.role: portion of the computation graph executed on the GPU

components.name: Merge & Sync
components.role: merges NPU and GPU partition outputs and synchronizes back to a single graph

content.key_idea: HeteroInfer statically partitions a weight tensor along its row dimension between NPU and GPU sub-tensors, executing the corresponding sub-graphs concurrently and merging their outputs back into a single graph.

summary: This figure illustrates HeteroInfer's weight-centric partitioning strategy for parallel GPU-NPU execution. At top, a matrix diagram shows the weight tensor (hidden_size x row) split along its row dimension into an NPU sub-tensor (top rows) and a GPU sub-tensor (bottom rows); multiplying by the activation tensor's transpose produces an output likewise split between NPU and GPU portions. At bottom, the corresponding Execution Graph shows how this partition is realized at runtime: a GPU-Graph splits and synchronizes into a parallel NPU sub-graph/partition and GPU sub-graph/partition, which are then merged and synchronized back into a single GPU-Graph. Orange consistently marks NPU-assigned elements and blue marks GPU-assigned elements across both halves of the figure, visually tying the static matrix partition to its dynamic graph-execution counterpart. The partition ratio itself is determined offline by a solver described elsewhere in the paper.
summary_zh: 该图展示HeteroInfer的权重中心划分策略：上半部分显示权重张量按行维度切分为NPU（上部行）与GPU（下部行）子张量，与激活张量转置相乘得到同样切分的输出；下半部分对应的执行图展示GPU-Graph经Split & Sync拆分为并行的NPU/GPU子图与分区，最终经Merge & Sync合并回GPU-Graph。全图以橙色标NPU、蓝色标GPU，划分比例由离线求解器静态确定。
